Run the R4SUB Readiness Pipeline End to End

Source: R/readiness.R
r4sub_readiness.Rd

Drives the installed R4SUB ecosystem packages over a single body of evidence and assembles their outputs into one consolidated readiness object. It is the ecosystem's "front door": instead of calling r4subscore, r4subrisk, r4subtrace, r4subusability, r4subrepro, and r4subprofile separately and stitching their results together by hand, you pass the shared evidence table once and receive every sibling's native result in a single structure.

Usage

r4sub_readiness(
  evidence,
  profile = NULL,
  sci_config = NULL,
  risk_config = NULL,
  include_evidence = FALSE
)

# S3 method for class 'r4sub_readiness'
format(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'r4sub_readiness'
print(x, ...)

Arguments

evidence

Either a single validated evidence table (conforming to the r4subcore evidence schema) or a list of such tables. A list is combined into one table with r4subcore::bind_evidence() before the pipeline runs; the combined table is what every stage sees.

profile

Optional. A submission_profile object from r4subprofile::submission_profile(). When supplied, the evidence is checked against it with r4subprofile::validate_against_profile(). When NULL (default), the profile stage is skipped.

sci_config

Optional scoring configuration from r4subscore::sci_config_default(), passed through to the scoring stage. When NULL (default), r4subscore's own default configuration is used; r4sub supplies no configuration values itself.

risk_config

Optional risk configuration from r4subrisk::risk_config_default(), passed through to the risk stage. When NULL (default), r4subrisk's own default configuration is used.

include_evidence

Logical. If TRUE, the (possibly combined) evidence table is returned in the evidence component of the result. Default FALSE.

x

An r4sub_readiness object, as returned by r4sub_readiness().

...

Ignored, for compatibility with the format() and print() generics.

Value

An object of class r4sub_readiness: a list with components

study_id

The study identifier read from the evidence.

n_evidence

The number of evidence rows the pipeline saw.

sci

The Submission Confidence Index from the scoring stage, or NA when that stage did not run.

band

The SCI decision band from the scoring stage, or NA.

generated_at

When the run was assembled.

stages

A named list, one entry per stage, each a list with stage, package, status ("ok", "skipped", or "error"), detail (a human-readable headline), result (the sibling's native return value, or NULL), and message.

summary

A tibble with one row per stage: stage, package, status, and detail.

evidence

The combined evidence table when include_evidence is TRUE, otherwise NULL.

Printing the object renders a readable report; the same text is available from format().

Details

r4sub_readiness() is a pure orchestrator: it computes no scores, weights, thresholds, or domain metrics of its own. Every number it surfaces is produced by the sibling package that owns that concern (for example the Submission Confidence Index and its band come from r4subscore::compute_sci(), the overall risk score from r4subrisk::compute_risk_scores()). r4sub only validates the evidence, invokes each sibling's existing entry points in dependency order, and collects what they return.

Each stage is run only when its package is installed (guarded with requireNamespace()) and is wrapped so that a sibling raising an error never aborts the whole run: that stage is recorded with status "error" and the others still complete. A stage whose package is not installed is recorded with status "skipped". The profile stage runs only when a profile is supplied.

Examples

ctx <- suppressMessages(
  r4subcore::r4sub_run_context(study_id = "STUDY01", environment = "DEV")
)
ev <- suppressMessages(r4subcore::as_evidence(
  data.frame(
    asset_type = "dataset",
    asset_id = c("ADSL", "ADAE"),
    source_name = "pinnacle21",
    indicator_id = c("Q-001", "R-001"),
    indicator_name = c("Quality check", "Risk check"),
    indicator_domain = c("quality", "risk"),
    severity = c("high", "critical"),
    result = c("fail", "fail"),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ),
  ctx = ctx
))
readiness <- r4sub_readiness(ev)
readiness$summary
#> # A tibble: 5 × 4
#>   stage     package        status detail                                   
#>   <chr>     <chr>          <chr>  <chr>                                    
#> 1 score     r4subscore     ok     SCI 0 (high_risk)                        
#> 2 risk      r4subrisk      ok     overall risk 0.49 across 2 risks         
#> 3 trace     r4subtrace     ok     no ADaM trace levels in evidence         
#> 4 usability r4subusability ok     no usability indicators in evidence      
#> 5 repro     r4subrepro     ok     no reproducibility indicators in evidence
